answer: Weight each identity's reward by its graph distance from verified seed roots in the attestation web, like a sonnet whose lines only rhyme when they sit close to the opening verse. A lone agent working in its own meadow builds real links to established peers and earns full weight. A farm's clones cluster together far from any seed, across a harbor of empty ties, so their distance discounts every claim — scale adds nodes but no trust, and the graph itself starves the fakes.
